title: Apyrous
summary: AP'YROUS, adjective [Gr. priv. and fire.] Incombustible, or that sustains a strong heat without alteration of form or properties. Apyrous bodies differ from those simply refractory. Refractory bodies

inlines.v: AP'YROUS, adjective [Gr. priv. and fire.] Incombustible, or that sustains a strong heat without alteration of form or properties. Apyrous bodies differ from those simply refractory. Refractory bodies cannot be fused by heat, but may be altered.
